input_oneliner: 44M day 3 of pancreatitis admit, NPO, passed out in bathroom right after urinating, pale and sweaty, back to baseline in a minute, HR 104

reference_targets_freetext.item: Orthostatic vital signs (supine to standing at 1 and 3 min)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: NPO with third-spacing makes volume depletion likely

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about prodrome (nausea, warmth, sweating, tunnel vision) and the sequence relative to micturition and standing
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Prodrome plus a micturition trigger supports reflex or situational syncope

reference_targets_freetext.item: Dry axillae / dry mucous membranes and prolonged capillary refill (hypovolemia signs)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Bedside hypovolemia signs quantify volume depletion in an NPO patient

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about oral intake, vomiting, and urine output over the last 24 hours
Witness account: duration, color, jerking, tongue biting, incontinence, post-event confusion; ask about injury
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Excludes seizure mimic; largely answered by rapid recovery in the base case

reference_targets_freetext.item: Calf circumference asymmetry >3 cm (10 cm below tibial tuberosity)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Three days immobile with pancreatitis carries VTE risk
Excludes a structural cause before attributing to a benign mechanism

should_not_recommend: Carotid sinus massage in a 44-year-old with a clear situational trigger
Head CT as a substitute for a witnessed-event history in a patient with no focal deficits

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: recovery: back to baseline in a minute -> confused for 20 minutes with a bitten tongue
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: 44M day 3 of pancreatitis admit, NPO, passed out in bathroom right after urinating, pale and sweaty, confused for 20 minutes after with bitten tongue, HR 104
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Witness account (tongue biting, incontinence, post-event confusion) becomes must_have and seizure_mimic enters the differential; focused neurologic exam for post-ictal deficit (Todd's paresis) is a new item; Orthostatic vital signs and hypovolemia signs remain must_have.

noise_variant.expected_change: None. Card should be substantially identical to base.
